summary: Rafal Stepien specializes in Buddhist studies and philosophy. He earned his PhD at Columbia University under Chün-fang Yü and Bernard Faure (attested 2015). He was an Academic Visitor at Wadham College (2012–2013) and an Exchange Scholar at Harvard University (attested 2015).

Rafał Felbur is a scholar of Buddhist studies and sinology. He studied as a PhD candidate at Stanford University (attested 2015) under doctoral supervisor Paul Harrison (attested 2018), and was also taught by John R. McRae and Luis Oscar Gómez.

Raffaele Catà is a scholar of philosophy and Indology. He completed his laurea at the University of Bologna (2011–2012) under the supervision of Manlio Iofrida and co-supervision of Saverio Marchignoli.
Raffaele Torella is an Indologist and philosopher who studied under Raniero Gnoli (~1970–1975). He served as a faculty member at Sapienza University of Rome from circa 1976 to 2020.
Raffaello Orlando is a scholar of sinology and Buddhist studies. He completed his PhD at Princeton University in 1981 under the doctoral supervision of Denis Twitchett.

Raghu Ananthanarayanan works in philosophy and religious studies. A postgraduate engineering alumnus of IIT Madras, he studied under Tirumalai Krishnamacharya and T. K. V. Desikachar. He taught at Krishnamacharya Yoga Mandiram and was a visiting faculty member at IIM Ahmedabad (attested 2010).

Raghu Vira was a scholar of Indology, Iranian and Central Asian studies, and Buddhist studies. He earned degrees from the University of the Punjab, University of London, and Leiden University. He headed Sanskrit at Sanatan Dharma College and founded the IAIC.

Raghunath Damodar Karmarkar was an Indology and philosophy scholar. He served as Principal of Sir Parashurambhau College (attested 1970) and held posts as Professor and Director of the Post-Graduate and Research Department at Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute.
Raghunath Giri was an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied under Vamacharana Bhattacharya. He served as a department head (科長) at Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith.

Rahul Peter Das is an Indologist and linguist who completed his D. Phil and Habilitation at the University of Hamburg. He taught at Hamburg, Bonn, Groningen, and Marburg, and held the South Asian studies chair at MLU Halle-Wittenberg (1994–2020).

Rahul Sankrityayan was an Indologist, Tibetologist, and Buddhist studies scholar. He held a teaching position in Sanskrit at Vidyalankara Pirivena (1927) and later taught Sanskrit and held a professorship at Saint Petersburg State University (1937, 1945–1947).

Raimo Anttila was a linguist and Indologist. He studied at Yale University (~1963–1966) under Warren Crawford Cowgill. He held academic posts at the University of California, Los Angeles (1965) and the University of Helsinki (1971–1976).

Raimon Panikkar worked in religious studies, philosophy, and Indology, earning doctorates from Complutense University of Madrid and Pontifical Lateran University. He held academic posts at Madrid (1946–1953), Harvard (1966–1971), and UC Santa Barbara (1971–1978; emeritus ~1987–2010).

Raimond Gaita is a philosopher who studied at the University of Melbourne and the University of Leeds. He held professorships at King's College London (1977–2011) and Australian Catholic University (1993–2011), and was an Honorary Professorial Fellow at Melbourne (2019).

Raja Ram Shastri was an Indologist who served as a Member of the Lok Sabha (~1971–1977) and as Chairman of the Managing Committee at Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University (attested 1976).

Rajan Gurukkal is a historian and Indologist who studied at the University of Calicut and Jawaharlal Nehru University. He served on the faculty at JNU, directed MGU's School of Social Sciences (1988), and was a visiting professor at IISc (2012–2016).

Rajan Khatiwoda is a scholar in Indology and history/archaeology. He served as a research assistant and cataloguer for the Nepalese-German Manuscript Cataloguing Project (~2003) and was an editorial board member for Documenta Nepalica (~2014).

Rajaram Hegde is a scholar of history, archaeology, and religious studies. Attested in 2010, he held appointments as Director at Kuvempu University and Director of the Centre for the Study of Local Cultures.
Rajat Verma works in computational studies and Indology. He has held positions at the Indian Institute of Technology Mandi and at BharatGen.

Rajeev Sangal works in computational linguistics and Indology. After studying at IIT Kanpur and the University of Pennsylvania, he held faculty posts at IIT Kanpur (1982–1998), IIIT Hyderabad (2002–2013, 2018–2022), and IIT (BHU) Varanasi (2013–2018).
